title: decide step config
description: Asks a decision model typed questions (choice, score, noul) about a context field and writes the answers to the context.

model_id.description: Logical id of a published decision model.

input_field.description: Context key holding the state; messages passes the chat messages as a list of role and content, and an empty value skips the step with a warning.

output_field.description: Prefix of the context keys written: <prefix>.<question id> holds the answer and, for choice and score, .confidence, .mode and .probabilities follow.

questions.description: Id to question map in declaration order, or the string request to take the caller's questions; set exactly one of questions and prompts.

oneOf.description: Take the questions from the decision call that targets the pipeline.

prompts.description: Id to prompt the step renders itself with the pipeline's Jinja context, for a model without a template; set exactly one of questions and prompts.

question.description: A typed question: instructions plus exactly one of choice, score or noul.

instructions.description: The question; a string, map or list reaches the template as is.

choice.description: Pick one option: option key to description (null allowed), or a list of bare keys; at least one option.

noul.description: Yes or no question; an optional true and false description may be given.

prompt.description: A prompt the step renders itself: a template plus exactly one of choice, score or noul describing the answer shape.

template.description: A workspace templates id, or inline Jinja rendered against the pipeline context; a bare name that is no templates id fails the load.

choice.description: Distinct, non-empty option keys in the order the prompt lists them.

noul.description: Yes or no answer; use an empty map.
